workshoptitle: Build Agents with Oracle AI Database Private Agent Factory

tutorials.title: Lab 1: Overview of Oracle AI Database Private Agent Factory
tutorials.description: Explore pre-built agents, templates, Agent Builder, utilities, and shared product resources.

tutorials.title: Lab 2: Create Knowledge Agent (KA) and Data Analysis (DA) Agents
tutorials.description: Create reusable agents for approved unstructured documents and structured data.

tutorials.title: Lab 3: Build an Agent from a Custom Template
tutorials.description: Import, inspect, test, and publish the Market Sync Agent template.

tutorials.title: Lab 4: Custom Agent with Exadata Database Service MCP Server
tutorials.description: Build and test a custom AI agent that queries sample retail data through the preconfigured Exadata Database Service MCP Server.

tutorials.title: Optional Lab 5: Linux Monitoring
tutorials.description: Optional 15-minute extension after Lab 3: check a Linux server and its applications with six read-only MCP tools and create a shift handover.

tutorials.title: Optional Lab 6: DBA Incident Detective
tutorials.description: Optional 20-minute extension after Lab 3: combine captured database incident evidence with a runbook and create an on-call handover.

tutorials.title: Need Help?
tutorials.description: Find solutions to common problems and ways to request help.
